scientific_integrity: Original contribution is the global kinetic conclusion and strict intolerance response for the specific 2026 destination-blind ODE; independent priority and proof verification are not performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic six-state large-neighborhood-number mean-field limit, two houses, positive blue/red occupancy and vacancy fractions, strictly positive baseline migration. No finite-population or L>=3 convergence guarantee; unspecified exponential rate. The static detailed-balance relations were described for different Schelling migration dynamics by Durrett and Zhang (2014).
title: Global exponential equilibration in a destination-blind two-house segregation model
